rationale: Package H adds private test-only portable realtime instrumentation for streaming contract allocation, lock, blocking, stale-result, and aliasing probes with clean and planted controls. Focused tests: pulp build --target pulp-test-streaming-model-contract; ./build/test/pulp-test-streaming-model-contract --reporter compact (93 assertions, 19 cases); ctest --test-dir build -R '^streaming model contract classifies callback and worker methods$' --output-on-failure. No design-import, rendering, packaging, or authority move occurs.
